title: Drop SQLite migration paths; assume fresh DB
description:
Current state: 

Desired state: 

Reason: 

DESIGN.md and ADR (.design/psp-etl-architecture.md) state the policy is 'on schema-version mismatch, drop and recreate the DB; everything is re-derivable from ROMs via ingest+analyze'. The current db.py keeps a defensive _MIGRATE_ENTRIES_UNIQUE migration that rebuilds the entries table from an old schema. For an opensource release we should drop all migrations and ship a clean CREATE TABLE schema. Tasks: remove _MIGRATE_ENTRIES_UNIQUE and _maybe_migrate_entries_constraint from src/psp_etl/db.py; consider whether to add a schema_version PRAGMA check that drops/recreates on mismatch, or just trust the schema. Update tests if any reference the migration path.
